phases.label: Phase 0
phases.scope: infrastructure, deployment configuration, runtime roots, schema bootstrap, bootstrap-admin preflight, object-store reachability, and fail-closed startup only.

phases.label: Phase 1
phases.scope: local authentication, session lifecycle, TOTP bootstrap or replacement, deployment-local user administration, and deployment-admin credential actions only.

phases.label: Phase 2
phases.scope: incident create or list or get or patch, bootstrap membership and workbook preferences, incident membership administration, incident-scoped authorization, extension discovery and reserved-family dispatch, plus the ordinary landing and incident-shell Phase 2 UI.

phases.label: Phase 3
phases.scope: Timeline workbook create, patch, query, lifecycle actions, replay stability, projection rebuild, save-state UI, and browser-visible collaboration behavior.

phases.label: Phase 4
phases.scope: entity mentions, resolve and merge routes, entity-origin Host and Identity creation, indicator create and query surfaces, Parties and coordination workbook surfaces, object-blob creation, evidence handle issuance, Timeline auto-resolution and manual relationship HTTP behavior, and the owned Phase 4 browser inspector flows.

phases.label: Phase 5
phases.scope: Evidence, blob lifecycle, evidence access, and object storage.

phases.label: Phase 6
phases.scope: Collaboration, presence, and same-field conflict resolution.

phases.label: Phase 7
phases.scope: Reviewer-facing history, delete or restore, and rollback.

phases.label: Phase 8
phases.scope: Links, tags, saved views, sorting, filtering, grouping, startup selection, and projection-backed query semantics.

phases.label: Phase 9
phases.scope: keyboard contract, clipboard and bulk-edit behaviors, Notes, Indicators, Parties, Assessments, Task Requests, Decisions, coordination surfaces, optional standardized surfaces when exposed, and remaining analyst-work workbook surfaces.

phases.label: Phase 10
phases.scope: Operational backup, restore, restore verification, public route absence, deployment-local operator boundary, and backup-storage binding.

phases.label: Phase 11
phases.scope: Selected Import Extension Profile route family and common job substrate only; Snapshot and Reporting, Reference Pack, Incident Portability, and Enterprise Authentication remain reserved and unclaimed.
phases.normative_owners: Core 00 §4.2 and §5.1; Core 01 §17 and §20; Core 04 extension-profile claim criteria; Core 05 only for claim-bearing timed or fixture-sensitive publication.
